messages:
kevin: Heads-up from scheduled repo-scan: workflow logs in repo infra/ci show a KMS-wrapped blob printed during the `deploy` job. :eyes:

mia: link to log snippet? paste it here?

devops-bot: [scan] secret pattern match in infra/ci/.github/workflows/deploy.yml at run 2026-03-15T12:11Z

kevin: here's the line:
```
2026-03-15T12:11:27Z DEBUG deploy: kms_wrapped_blob=Ci0tQkFTRTY0L...==
```

olivia: that's a KMS ciphertext. which key? can someone check with KMS audit logs? :lock:

samir: running `gcloud kms decrypt --ciphertext-file=...` is not an option here. but the blob header shows key id `projects/rdw-prod/locations/global/keyRings/ci/cryptoKeys/deploy`

mia: if it's KMS-wrapped, plaintext might still be a service token. need to rotate the underlying SA keys and revoke any short-lived tokens. I'll triage.

kevin: containment plan: 1) disable affected workflow in repo 2) pause self-hosted runners 3) rotate service account `ci-deployer@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com` 4) scrub logs and mark as SEV3 until we know impact

olivia: I disabled the workflow and placed the repo in read-only. paused the runners.

devops-bot: runner pool status: paused (3 machines)

samir: I'm pulling GCP KMS access logs now. running query for access to key `ci/deploy` between 2026-03-14..2026-03-16

mia: initial KMS audit: decrypt calls show only our runner service SA and an external monitoring SA (monitor-tool@thirdparty.com). external SA had a decrypt entry at 12:11:27.

kevin: third-party monitoring SA was used in older integrations — we thought it was retired. assume compromise unless proven otherwise. rotate keys and disable thirdparty access.

olivia: kicked the thirdparty oauth client and removed their IAM binding. opened ticket SOC-219 to track.

samir: rotated `ci-deployer` keys and created new key version for the KMS key. rotated tokens for deployer SA. pushed new secrets to Secret Manager, updated workflows to use SM, not plaintext debug prints.

mia: scrubbed logs via GitHub support request and removed exported artifacts. PR to strip the `echo $KMS_WRAPPED_BLOB` debug left in the workflow: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/452

kevin: action items: (A) retro-audit all workflows for `echo`/`print` of env vars (B) enforce runner sandboxing + redact env by default (C) rotate any SA keys whose KMS decrypt was called with thirdparty token

olivia: filing a post-incident review. assigned to @kevin @mia for remediation notes and timeline.

mia: timeline draft: discovery 12:30, containment 12:45, rotations 13:05, logs scrubbed 14:20. I'll upload to incident board.

kevin: +1. Also enabling alert rule on repo-scan to flag KMS ciphertext pattern and additional telemetry on runner env prints.

devops-bot: incident created: IR-2026-0315-01

samir: one more — add automated workflow linter to CI to fail if `echo` or `cat` references env vars or Secret Manager args are printed.

olivia: noted. thanks all. postmortem due EOD Friday. :white_check_mark:
